facts.text: Pass the Oreos and peanut butter. Dad won't notice the swap while we eat.
facts.why: Printed as Hallie's words, but she never says it. In the isolation bunk Hallie offers Oreos, Annie says she eats them with peanut butter, and Hallie pulls out a jar and says 'So do I!'.
facts.fix: That is so weird... So do I!

fix_note.text: That is so weird... So do I!

facts.text: Crustless white bread with butter, cucumber and dill, the London butler's tea tray
facts.why: Martin is the London butler, but none of the sources opened show a tea tray or cucumber sandwiches in the film.
facts.fix: Crustless white bread with butter, cucumber and dill, the way Martin the butler would send it up

vibe.verdict: Right camp and the Oreos with peanut butter, but it skips the pranks and the best Meredith moments.
missing: Honey in the shoes and chocolate syrup in the bucket (bunkhouse prank)
Meredith dragged into the lake on her mattress (camping trip)
Annie and Hallie's fencing match and poker game (camp)
Nick falling into the hotel pool when he sees Elizabeth (San Francisco)
Dinner on the yacht that recreates the night the parents met
Martin and Annie's handshake goodbye (camp drop-off)
ideas: Swap 'London afternoon tea scones' for a 'Bunkhouse prank sundae' with honey and chocolate syrup.
Swap 'Camping trip snags with fried onions' note for 'Meredith's mattress ends up in the lake'.
Add the twins' 'That is so weird... So do I!' to the Oreo and peanut butter dip note.
